articles.summary: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. articles.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
articles.summary: Modern AI agents rely on elaborate inference harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to drive multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and access to external systems.
